onlyOwner modifier on ownerClaim() checks owner() == _msgSender().
onlyOwner modifier on withdraw() checks owner() == _msgSender().

block.timestamp is folded into the keccak256 seed inside random(), creating timestamp dependency.
random() output selects which token ID claim() mints, propagating timestamp dependency.
random() output selects which token ID ownerClaim() mints, propagating timestamp dependency.
